description: Dashboard Widgets - Add Top 10/50/100/500 filter dropdowns, Post IDs, User IDs, and Copy ID actions to the feed analytics widgets. Also update backend to accept a limit query parameter.
steps: 1. In backend/src/modules/admin/admin.controller.js: Update getFeedAnalytics to extract a 'limit' query parameter from req.query and pass it to adminService.getFeedAnalytics(limit)
2. In backend/src/modules/admin/admin.service.js: Update getFeedAnalytics to accept a limit parameter (default 10), and use .limit(limit) instead of hardcoded .limit(5) for all three queries
3. In admin/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Add a state variable for the feed limit filter (default 10, options: 10, 50, 100, 500)
4. Add a dropdown/select element above the feed analytics grid that allows switching between Top 10/50/100/500
5. Pass the selected limit as a query parameter when fetching /admin/feed-analytics?limit=N
6. For Most Liked Posts and Most Saved Posts widgets: show the Post ID (truncated with mono font) and a Copy button next to each post entry
7. For Most Followed Artists widget: show the User ID (truncated with mono font) and a Copy button next to each artist entry
8. Add copiedId state management similar to Posts.tsx pattern (using navigator.clipboard.writeText)
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows a filter dropdown with options: Top 10, Top 50, Top 100, Top 500
Changing the filter re-fetches feed analytics with the new limit
Each post in Most Liked/Most Saved shows its _id with a copy button
Each artist in Most Followed shows their _id with a copy button
Backend accepts limit query param and returns the requested number of results
verification: Verify no syntax errors in modified files
findings: All changes verified: backend JS files pass node -c syntax check, admin TypeScript compiles cleanly with tsc --noEmit. The feed analytics endpoint now accepts a limit query param (default 10) instead of hardcoded 5. The Dashboard has a select dropdown for Top 10/50/100/500, shows post/artist IDs with copy buttons using navigator.clipboard API.
